name: OpenMobile-2 HD hub redraw
generationType: New high-definition redraw based on the official mascot; not an original official release asset and not a pixel upscale.

references.role: Material rendering and line-quality reference only

prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: high-definition transparent project mascot for the OpenMobile-2 research hub, displayed at 64–120 CSS pixels.
Primary request: Redraw the low-resolution mascot in Image 1 from scratch at crisp high resolution while preserving its recognizable identity and overall composition. This is a newly rendered illustration, not an enlarged or sharpened pixel image.
Input images: Image 1 is the target identity and composition reference: a blue-and-white small robot standing on a glowing mobile-platform base while holding an upright smartphone. Image 2 is ONLY the reference for clean material rendering, refined line quality, and polished blue/white robot-family style. Do not borrow its seated pose, radar tablet, checklist, or charts.
Subject and invariants: Keep the round white robot shell, dark navy face, expressive cyan-ring eyes, small antenna and round ears; keep the standing pose, hand-held phone on the viewer's left, blue/green map-like platform, and a few floating app symbols. Keep the palette cyan blue, mint green, white, navy, with restrained golden accents. The mobile phone should be immediately recognizable, with a clean simple app grid and no text. Preserve the friendly intelligent research-mascot character.
Style and quality: Precise, refined illustrated materials with smooth enamel-like white panels, rich blue shading, crisp navy contours, restrained highlights and readable surface details. Render all shapes cleanly; no pixelation, blurry edges, oversharpening halos or gritty texture. It must feel like a carefully drawn member of Image 2's visual family, not an emoji.
Composition: One compact complete mascot centered on a square canvas with comfortable transparent padding. Robot and phone are the dominant readable silhouette. The platform is a clean compact rounded map-like base with one small golden location marker. Use only two or three larger clear floating app symbols and a few clean connected arcs. Remove the swarm of tiny fragmented pixel particles. Keep all limbs, phone, platform and symbols fully inside the canvas.
Backdrop: Genuine transparent alpha, including the spaces between detached elements. No rectangular background, white plate, gray checkerboard, solid color field, glow haze covering the canvas, border, watermark, or lettering.
Text: None.
Output: A clean high-resolution transparent PNG suitable for dark and light website themes, with crisp details and strong readability at 64–120px.

preserved: Cyan, mint and restrained gold palette
